examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the home page places it: two customer stories in the framed grid, the first one spanning two columns and two rows, followed by six client marks on mixed fills. A band with no stories and no logos renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Ordered cells
examples.summary: `cells` places story and mark tiles in one ordered list, each with its own `span` and `rows`, as the home page does: Netshoes leads two by two, three marks follow, GPA runs two rows tall with its stacked lockup one step taller, and the mark on the `primary` fill takes the knockout ink. `anchor` makes the band a `#clients` target.

site.name: Default
site.summary: The Home mosaic in four columns, two on a phone. Netshoes leads as a large story tile, GPA runs two rows tall, and six logo tiles fill the rest.
